How do I add user image flairs; I have a style sheet that I use for the upvoat/downvoat buttons, so how do I use those same images for user flairs?

You'll have to use an ":after" selector on them, creating a new rule for each user you wish to give a flair. You would need to set the code to be something like the following:

#container a[href$='/user/Ar_Nimruzir']:after {
 content: " ";
 position: absolute;
 height: 19px;
 width: 19px;
 background: url('https://slimgur.com/images/2015/07/09/d874f430e9171d6421fa4224ca64797b.png') 50% no-repeat;
 right: -20px;
 background-size: contain;
}
.comment a.submitter.author, .comment a.moderator.author {
 position: relative;
 margin-right: 21px;
}

Add this to the bottom of your code, and that should work nicely.

This idea is a bit broad but relevant. There's a comment I keep seeing about Voat:

"Eventually, Voat will become so big that in order to keep the site afloat they'll have to bow down to the money men and throw Free Speech to the wayside and become just like Reddit is now"

To me, that reveals Reddit's fatal flaw. They're obsessed with scaling up, becoming bigger and bigger, creating a bubble that bursts unless they stop serving the community and start serving the venture capitalists.

To avoid repeating history and to maintain the vision of a space that is a place where Free Speech and Expression is paramount, Voat needs to become a sustainable ecosystem. Voat doesn't need to be the new front page of the internet, it doesn't need at the forefront of popular culture.

It doesn't need to be big or popular, it needs to be consistent and stable. A constant stream of activity from the community while not being so bloated that it needs 700 servers and 5-8 million dollars to pay for server costs like Reddit does now. If that goal can be achieved, then Voat will maintain its integrity and have a long, healthy life.
Avoid the mistake Reddit made: Voat needs to build an ecosystem, not a bubble

I feel these are the questions that need answering, not speculation, to truly become great.
